**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 279 **Usage** held in 1 hand **Bulk** 1 --- An array of dazzling gemstones lines the twisting head of the golden staff. While wielding the staff, you gain a +1 status bonus to [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) checks to make a Request. **Activate** Cast a Spell; **Effect** You expend a number of charges from the staff to cast a spell from its list. **Craft Requirements** Supply one casting of all listed ranks of all listed spells. Staff of Control **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 279 **Price** 230 gp ---
  • **Cantrip** [_daze_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1482)
  • **1st** [_charm_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1463), [_command_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1470)
  • **2nd** [_laughing fit_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1583), [_stupefy_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1691)
Staff of Control (Greater) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 279 **Price** 900 gp ---
  • **3rd** [_enthrall_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1516)
  • **4th** charm, [_confusion_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1471), [_suggestion_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1693)
Staff of Control (Major) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 279 **Price** 4,000 gp ---
  • **5th** command, [_subconscious suggestion_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1692)
  • **6th** [_dominate_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1501), [_never mind_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1614)
name: Staff of Control (Greater)
